project_info.theme: Student success profile for ESSEC Business School admission
project_info.color_palette: White, Red, Navy, Soft Gray, Campus Green

main_subject.detail: A student profile poster featuring the name 'Hành Hà', the red badge '2K8 TP. HCM', a long achievement list about admission to Global BBA ESSEC Business School, plus taped scrapbook-style student and campus photos on the right.
main_subject.style: Editorial admissions success poster with scrapbook paper textures, structured bullet achievements, institutional branding, and advisory CTA.

items: Top Left: VFE logo and elegant red calligraphic initial next to the name 'Hành Hà'.
Top Right: Taped portrait photo of the student in graduation robe and a second taped campus building photo clipped with a red paperclip illustration.
Bottom Left: ESSEC Business School logo and ranking bullet points beneath the student achievement list.
Bottom Right: Large red rounded CTA button 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'.
Center/Background: Clean white paper-like background with dotted texture, red framing nodes around the achievements panel, and structured black/red typography.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Paper-texture subtlety, clean portrait-photo visibility, controlled contrast for long text blocks, and polished admissions-brochure aesthetics.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality admissions success poster for VFE and ESSEC Business School. Centerpiece is a detailed student profile titled 'Hành Hà', badge '2K8 TP. HCM', and headline 'TÂN SINH VIÊN GLOBAL BBA ESSEC BUSINESS SCHOOL', with extensive bullet-point achievements on the left and scrapbook-style student and campus photos on the right. Background is a clean textured white editorial layout with red frame accents. Surrounding elements: VFE logo, ESSEC logo, ranking statements about Financial Times 2025 and Le Figaro Étudiant 2026, and red CTA button 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'. Technical style: editorial scrapbook admissions poster, soft editorial daylight print-style lighting, clean structured typography, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
